claims: Wright State University is located in Fairborn, Ohio.
Fairborn, Ohio is a suburb approximately eight miles northeast of downtown Dayton.
Wright State University's main campus is adjacent to the Wright-Patterson Air Force Base.
Wright State University has a second branch campus located in Celina, Ohio.
Wright State University's second branch campus in Celina, Ohio is called Lake Campus.
Wright State University's address is 3640 Colonel Glenn Hwy, Fairborn, OH 45324.
Wright State University is situated in western Ohio.
Wright State University is roughly 58 miles southwest of Columbus.
Wright State University is roughly 71 miles northeast of Cincinnati.
Wright State University is located within a 16-county region known as "Raider Country".
